comment: Non-secret Launchpad SDK settings. OAuth credentials live in credentials.json and are merged in by scripts/generate-sdk-config.js to produce sdk-config.json.

authConfig.noPKCE_comment: The confidential Launchpad OAuth client rejects PKCE. Needs patches/@pega+auth+0.2.47.patch (applied by npm install). Remove once a public PKCE client is registered.

serverConfig.infinityRestServerUrl_comment: Dev server URL; proxies /dx requests to the real Launchpad server URL configured in webpack.config.js
